articles.title: THE PRE-SHOT ROUTINE AS MEDITATION
articles.description: Why the 90 seconds before you swing is the most important practice in golf.
articles.body: In the ancient wisdom tradition, every physical action carries an internal counterpart. When standing on the tee box, the stillness of mind reflects Krishna’s counsel to Arjuna: release the attachment to victory or defeat, and focus purely on the devotion of the present stroke.

faqs.question: Do I need to know the Bhagavad Gita to read this?
faqs.answer: No. Each chapter introduces the teaching in plain language before showing how it plays out on the course.

faqs.question: Is this a religious book?
faqs.answer: No. The Gita is treated here as a text about the mind, action, and attention. Readers of any belief, or none, will find it useful.

faqs.question: Is it available as an ebook?
faqs.answer: Yes. Golf Gita is available on Kindle and as an ePub. See the 'Where to buy' links for options.

faqs.question: Can I bulk-order for a club or corporate event?
faqs.answer: Yes. Please get in touch through the Contact page and we will help with bulk and corporate orders.

book.title: Golf Gita
book.kicker: The Eternal Game of Celestial Wisdom.
book.para_1: Golf Gita blends the art of golf with the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita, guiding readers through ego, duality and balance towards inner clarity, purposeful action and freedom beyond the scorecard.
book.para_2: Golf Gita is a personal journal and guided exploration of golf’s inner game through the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita. It is neither a technical golf manual nor a final authority on the Gita. Its 18 holes offer mirrors for ego, fear, desire, balance and awareness, not a fixed sequence of lessons. Read in order or turn to what speaks to you today. The course has numbers. The mind does not.
book.seo_description: Golf Gita blends the art of golf with the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita, guiding readers through ego, duality and balance towards inner clarity.

author.name: Nazeer Tajudeen
author.bio_1: Nazeer Tajudeen discovered golf in 2000 and left corporate life in 2005 to coach full-time. His journey from artist to executive to teacher brings creativity and insight to his work. Raised along the Thailand–Laos border and later in southern India, he grew up among diverse faiths and cultures that quietly shaped his outlook on life.
author.bio_2: Golf Gita grew from two decades of coaching and his own struggles with the game. Through public mishits, persistence and reflection, he explored how ego, fear, expectations and awareness shape both performance and personal growth.
author.bio_3: Recognized globally as a Top 50 coach by WGTF and U.S. Kids Golf in 2024, Nazeer teaches golfers aged 5 to 85. He welcomes beginners and helps struggling players regain confidence and joy.
author.quote: Golf Gita grew from my own struggles with the game, and the discovery that understanding ourselves matters as much as understanding the swing
